description: Iron Age Timber causeway which is thought to have been used for ritual depositions from the Iron Age to the Roman period. Earliest finds seem to be Middle Iron Age, and Roman pottery finds take it to the 3rd CE, though it is suggested that it's use goes further.
bibliography: Field, and Parker Pearson. “An Iron Age Timber Causeway with Iron Age and Roman Votive Offerings: The 1981 Excavations,” 2003.
Martyn, Blick, Brindle, and et al. “Fiskerton (Lincolnshire).” The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: an online resource, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
